content.short: Sonic is an EVM compatible Layer 1 built for DeFi, with sub-second finality and fees around a tenth of a cent.
content.description: Sonic is an EVM compatible Layer 1 blockchain built by the team behind Fantom, aimed at decentralized finance workloads that need speed without leaving the Solidity ecosystem. It confirms transactions in under a second at an average cost near one tenth of a cent, and a bridge connects it to Ethereum for liquidity. Its distinguishing feature is Fee Monetization, a protocol level program that returns up to ninety percent of the fees an application generates back to the team that built it, turning gas into a direct revenue stream for developers.
content.meta: Sonic is an EVM compatible Layer 1 for DeFi with sub-second finality and developer fee sharing. Discover Sonic on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
